name: 2000 Prairie Avenue — Frame dwelling (district draft; refined by T-1909)

function.note: The 1911 sheet marks the building 'D' (dwelling): '3BB frame dwelling (D), set back on a deep lawn at the 20th Street corner'. Carried to 1904 on the T-1842 census ruling (present_as_mapped).

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-2351, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1909 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 35 trace (s35fp-2000-b2), the T-1842 census (s35-2000-front, s35-2000-wing) and the T-1837 register row frontage-35-059 (Frame dwelling); every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-prairie-20-22-west-2351).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-1842 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

position.symbolic_location: 2000 S. Prairie Avenue, parcel prairie_2000 (data/street_grid/1904.json), west side of Prairie Avenue, Prairie Avenue, 20th to 22nd Street (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 35).
position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 22.000, v 21.250 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy. Rotation -0.593 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.

derivation.reason: The four derivation methods re-derive from the 1835 files; this position is re-derived from the traced sheet and the 1904 parcel by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py --check instead.

footprint.note: The main body: the largest rectangle that fits inside the traced main part (u toward the street, v along the front), widened to 5.5 m along the front because the fitted strip was narrower than any house of the avenue (T-2690). The building's other rectangles are in draft_plan.

stories.note: '3BB; section2BB' printed on the 1911 sheet: 3 full storeys.

construction.note: The register reads the map's colours as 'frame'.
